messages.subject: Senior International Executive Profile | Corporate Affairs, Regulatory Relations, ESG & Banking
messages.body:
Dear maib Human Resources Team,

I am submitting my profile for consideration for senior current or future leadership opportunities where corporate affairs, government and regulatory relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and banking experience intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This gives me a useful combination of banking perspective, institutional engagement, responsible-business leadership and executive-level stakeholder management.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Regulatory Strategy, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country-facing leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a maib-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for suitable current or future senior mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
